# Cercles

> Cercles (Cercles Full-Circle Living) is a one-stop home solutions company based in Kozhikode (Calicut), Kerala, India. One team, one quotation and one schedule for every part of a home: interiors, curtains, sofas, furniture, painting, electrical, plumbing, roofing and waterproofing, ACP facades, aluminium fabrication, rainwater gutters, landscaping and irrigation. Projects across Kerala. Any service can be booked on its own or combined into one complete project.

Contact: +91 75599 42708 (phone and WhatsApp), cerclesindia@gmail.com, Instagram @cercles.in
